name: What are common signs that my garbage disposal needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my garbage disposal needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your garbage disposal needs repair include unusual noises like humming or grinding, foul odors that persist even after cleaning, leaks from the unit, or a complete failure to turn on. If your disposal frequently jams, struggles to grind food, or drains slowly, it's also a strong indicator that professional attention is needed. Often, a humming sound without grinding indicates a jammed flywheel, which can sometimes be cleared by the homeowner, but persistent issues require a plumber to diagnose the underlying mechanical or electrical problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Unusual noises, leaks, foul odors, or a failure to turn on are common signs your garbage disposal needs repair. A humming sound might indicate a jam.
